SummaryOfPosition.Summary: The Respondent denies negligence and contends that its due diligence was conducted competently, that any errors were not reasonably discoverable, and that the Appellant's losses resulted from post-acquisition business decisions.

FactsReliedOn.item: The due diligence was conducted in accordance with professional standards.
The fraud was sophisticated and designed to evade detection.
The Appellant had access to additional information that it chose not to investigate.
The Appellant's post-acquisition losses were caused by operational decisions, not the acquisition price.
The limitation period has expired for claims arising from the February 2021 report.

Contentions.item: The scope of duty did not extend to detecting sophisticated fraud.
The Appellant is contributorily negligent for failing to conduct its own enquiries.
The losses claimed are too remote.
